verdict.rationale: Docs confirm image input support ("All current models support text and image input... vision"), but the evidence pack does not mention audio input at all, and document handling is only evidenced via Agent Skills for document tasks (PowerPoint/Excel/Word/PDF), not raw document upload to the Messages API. missing for 10: explicit documentation of audio input support (or an honest scoping statement excluding audio), and clearer documentation of direct document/PDF input to the Messages API beyond Skills-based processing.
